system_source.weights: huggingface.co/facebook/map-anything (CC BY-NC 4.0, non-commercial use); SALAD + DINOv2 for loop detection

deviations_from_defaults: Input frame rate 10 Hz instead of 30 Hz (frame_step 3), identical to VGGT-Long; see config/systems/vggt_long.yaml.

calib: True: the D435i intrinsics (calibration.md) are given to MapAnything instead of its own estimate (upstream default False). Same as map_long otherwise, so the two rows show the effect of known intrinsics.

hardware.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition, 97887 MiB
